AMERICAN
Americas Leading Airline

AMERICAN MAKES HISTORY
WITH THE
First Nonstop Service
Coast To Coast
IN BOTH DIRECTIONS
NEW YORK
LOS ANGELES
American's new DC-7 Flagship will fly you cross-
country in under 8 hours. This unmatched travel
time is made possible by the 365 mph cruising
speed of the fastest piston-powered transport in
the world. With the new DC-7, American con-
tinues to set the standard for service in trans-
continental travel.
The DC-7 features many new developments de-
signed for your comfort-special soundproofing,
even more comfortable seats, and air condition-
ing on the ground as well as in the air. Twenty-
five DC-7 Flagships will be added to the Fleet
by mid 1954. This means more nonstop transcon-
tinental service and the introduction of this supe-
rior plane to other cities throughout the nation.
AMERICAN AIRLINES INC.
